zh.runtime.title: 运行时记忆
zh.runtime.description: 管理每轮随上下文加载的紧凑热记忆。结构化数据由统一控制层维护，并自动投影为 USER.md 与 MEMORY.md。
zh.runtime.noMatch: 没有符合当前范围与查询条件的热记忆。
zh.runtime.addDescription: 稳定但仍需频繁使用的信息优先留在这里，长期归档由 Mnemon 记忆体承接。
zh.runtime.placeholder: 输入一条简洁、独立、未来仍然有用的信息…
zh.runtime.target.user.description: 身份、角色、习惯、表达偏好与明确的协作要求；容量整理始终留在本地，不进入记忆体。
zh.runtime.target.memory.description: 项目、环境、决策、约定、工具特性与可复用经验；容量达到上限时按主题归档到一个或多个记忆体。
zh.runtime.branchesPlaceholder: 如 main、dev（逗号分隔；留空=全部分支可见）
zh.runtime.branchesHint: 留空表示清除分支限制（全部分支可见）
zh.runtime.removeWarning: 移除后，这条内容将不再随每轮上下文加载。该操作无法撤销。
zh.runtime.result.add: 已添加到{target} · 当前 {count} 条
zh.runtime.result.replace: 已更新{target} · 当前 {count} 条
zh.runtime.result.remove: 已从{target}移除 · 当前 {count} 条
zh.runtime.result.maintenance: 容量整理完成：已先归档到记忆体 {spaces}，再更新{target} · 当前 {count} 条
zh.runtime.result.localCompaction: 本地画像整理完成：未写入记忆体，已更新{target} · 当前 {count} 条
zh.runtime.readOnly: 当前部署为只读模式；热记忆仍会进入上下文，但不能在此修改。
zh.runtime.footnote: memories.json 是唯一事实源；两个 Markdown 文件由控制层生成，不应直接编辑。

en.runtime.title: Runtime Memory
en.runtime.description: Manage compact hot memory loaded into every turn. A single control plane owns structured data and projects USER.md and MEMORY.md.
en.runtime.noMatch: No hot memory matches the current scope and query.
en.runtime.addDescription: Keep stable, frequently useful information here; Mnemon Memory Spaces remain the durable archive.
en.runtime.placeholder: Enter one compact, self-contained fact that will remain useful…
en.runtime.target.user.description: Identity, role, habits, communication preferences, and explicit collaboration requirements. Capacity maintenance stays local and never enters a Memory Space.
en.runtime.target.memory.description: Projects, environment, decisions, conventions, tool behavior, and reusable lessons. At capacity, entries are routed into one or more topic-specific Memory Spaces.
en.runtime.branchesPlaceholder: e.g. main, dev (comma-separated; empty = visible on all branches)
en.runtime.branchesHint: Empty input clears the branch restriction (visible on all branches)
en.runtime.removeWarning: After removal, this content will no longer load with every turn. This action cannot be undone.
en.runtime.result.maintenance: Capacity maintenance complete: archived to {spaces}, then updated {target} · {count} entries
en.runtime.result.localCompaction: Local profile compaction complete: no Memory Space write; updated {target} · {count} entries
en.runtime.readOnly: This deployment is read only. Hot memory still enters context but cannot be changed here.
en.runtime.footnote: memories.json is the only source of truth. The control plane generates both Markdown files; do not edit them directly.
